points.label: Community resources
points.left: Paul calls readers to be strong in the Lord and put on God’s whole armor against the devil’s schemes. He names rulers and spiritual forces. He then calls them to stand with truth, righteousness, peace, faith, salvation, God’s word, prayer, and bold speech.
points.right: Peter calls for humility under God’s hand and for casting anxiety on him. He also calls for clear thinking and watchfulness because the devil prowls like a roaring lion. Readers must resist him in faith amid shared suffering. God will restore and strengthen them, and dominion belongs to him.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Believers resist the adversary devil who prowls like a lion

payload.tension: Both call for resistance. They use different images and name different ways the community can respond.
payload.title: Standing firm against schemes and a prowling foe
